name: PDF
description: Create paginated A4 PDF artifacts with CJK text support.
instructions: Use write_pdf for a requested text PDF and pass the full final Markdown. The writer preserves intentional line breaks and automatically wraps and paginates long prose.
Confirm the workspace approval and successful tool result before presenting the file as complete.

The built-in writer supports A4 text pages, Markdown-aware headings, page numbers, and CJK characters. Verify every final page is approximately 595 x 842 points; a 612 x 792 point page is US Letter and fails an A4 academic-document requirement.

Render and inspect every page before completion. Reject blank interior pages, placeholder table-of-contents pages, clipped or garbled text, missing abstracts/references, and a PDF whose visible structure differs from the source DOCX. Do not claim images, forms, or pixel-perfect institutional templates unless separately verified.
